desc: The Master Lock No. 4688D Set Your Own Combination TSA-Accepted Luggage Lock features a 1-3/16in (30mm) wide metal body for durability. The 1/8in (3mm) diameter shackle is 1-1/2in (38mm) long and made of vinyl covered flexible braided steel, offering resistance to abuse from baggage handling equipment. Transportation Security Administration (TSA) screeners can open, inspect and relock bags locked with a TSA-Accepted lock. Lock your checked baggage with the lock TSA screeners won't cut!
